The difference here is that you can also get a cutting-edge facial. And if you have hyperpigmentation after too much summer basking, it’s Jack’s Pigmentation Facial that you’ll be after. Downtime is only about a day, and three sessions one month apart are recommended. The result is brighter skin with a more even tone, and faded pigmentation.
